"""AT-03 / FR-002 / INV-001: normal approval path and transaction idempotence.

Cash 100000, zero positions, price 100; the operator approves 100 shares. The
first execution debits cash to 90000 and records 100 shares with the approver,
approval version and passed policy checks. Executing the same proposal again is
a no-op — no double debit.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from research_desk.models import ProposalStatus, utcnow_iso
from research_desk.review import approve, create_proposal, execute


def _proposal(*, signal="Buy", price=100.0, proposal_id=None):
    return create_proposal(
        run_id="run-test",
        ticker="AAPL",
        trade_date="2026-06-10",
        signal=signal,
        rating=signal,
        price=price,
        proposal_id=proposal_id or f"prop-at03-{utcnow_iso()[-9:]}",
    )


def test_at03_approve_execute_records_and_idempotent(store):
    """First execution debits cash and records shares; re-execution is a no-op."""
    proposal = _proposal()
    store.save_proposal(proposal)

    approved = approve(proposal, shares=100, operator="leo")
    store.save_proposal(approved)
    assert approved.approved_version  # approval bound to this exact proposal version

    updated, execution = execute(store, store.get_proposal(proposal.proposal_id), operator="leo")
    ledger = store.get_ledger()
    assert execution.executed is True
    assert execution.tx_id
    assert ledger.cash == 90000.0  # 100000 - 100*100
    assert ledger.positions["AAPL"].shares == 100
    assert ledger.positions["AAPL"].avg_price == 100.0
    assert updated.status == ProposalStatus.SIMULATED
    assert execution.policy_checks  # the deterministic policy results are recorded

    # The proposal itself carries the approver/version/policy trail (INV-001).
    stored = store.get_proposal(proposal.proposal_id)
    assert stored.operator == "leo"
    assert stored.approved_version == approved.approved_version

    # Idempotence: executing the same proposal again changes nothing.
    before = store.get_ledger()
    re, rex = execute(store, store.get_proposal(proposal.proposal_id), operator="leo")
    after = store.get_ledger()
    assert re.status == ProposalStatus.SIMULATED
    assert rex.reason == "already executed"
    assert after.cash == before.cash == 90000.0
    assert after.positions["AAPL"].shares == 100
    assert len(store.list_transactions()) == 1  # no second transaction


def test_at03_exact_cap_boundary_allowed(store):
    """100 shares @ 100 on 100000 cash is exactly the 10% cap: allowed."""
    from research_desk.models import LedgerState

    assert verdict.allowed is True

 class BudgetTracker:
     """Thread-safe per-run call budget + usage accumulator.
 
     ``stop_reason`` distinguishes an *actually blocked* next call (a request was
     refused with :class:`BudgetExhausted`) from a normal completion that simply
     used at most ``max_calls`` calls. A run that reaches the limit on its final
     allowed call without ever requesting another is ``completed``; only a run
     whose next call was refused is ``budget_exhausted``.

     max_calls: int | None = None
     _lock: threading.Lock = field(default_factory=threading.Lock, repr=False)
     calls_started: int = 0
     blocked: bool = False  # a call was actually refused (BudgetExhausted raised)
     usage: UsageSummary = field(default_factory=UsageSummary)
 
     def can_start(self) -> bool:
         """Whether a new LLM call is permitted under the budget."""
         if self.max_calls is None:
             return True
         return self.calls_started < self.max_calls
 
     def start_call(self) -> None:
         """Register the start of an LLM call; raise when budget exhausted."""
         with self._lock:
             limit = self.max_calls
             if limit is not None and self.calls_started >= limit:
                 self.blocked = True
                 raise BudgetExhausted(limit)
             self.calls_started += 1
 
     def record_usage(self, usage: CallUsage) -> None:
         with self._lock:
             self.usage.add(usage)
 
     def stop_reason(self) -> str:
         if self.blocked:
             return "budget_exhausted"
         return "completed"
 
     def summary(self) -> UsageSummary:
         with self._lock:
             return UsageSummary(
                 calls=self.calls_started,
                 input_tokens=self.usage.input_tokens,
                 output_tokens=self.usage.output_tokens,
                 total_tokens=self.usage.total_tokens,
                 stop_reason=self.stop_reason(),

         with self._lock:
             self.calls_started += other.calls_started
             self.blocked = self.blocked or other.blocked
             self.usage.calls += other.usage.calls
             self.usage.input_tokens += other.usage.input_tokens
             self.usage.output_tokens += other.usage.output_tokens

 # A monetary number token in ordinary report formatting: optional ``$``/spaces,
 # an explicit sign, US thousands separators, and a decimal fraction. Ungrouped
 # integers of any length match, correctly grouped comma amounts match, and the
 # sign stays part of the numeric value so ``-451.10`` is never read as
 # ``451.10``. The boundaries reject a digit/comma/dot directly before and a
 # digit directly after, so the match is never a substring of a larger number
 # like ``1451.10`` for an expected ``451.10``.
 _PRICE_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(
     r"(?<![\d.,])\$?\s*[+-]?\s*(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?!\d)"
 )
 
 
 def _normalize_number_token(token: str) -> Decimal | None:
     """Parse a matched number token (``$``/commas removed, sign kept) into a Decimal."""
     cleaned = token.replace(",", "").replace("$", "").strip()
     try:
         return Decimal(cleaned)
     except InvalidOperation:
         return None
 
 
 def _contains_price(text: str, expected_close: float) -> bool:
     """True when ``text`` states the expected close as its own number token.
 
     Ordinary formatting is normalized ($451.10, 451.1, comma thousands, trailing
     zeros), so the check accepts exactly the expected numerical value and never
     a different number or a substring of a larger number.
     """
     expected = Decimal(f"{expected_close:.2f}")
     for match in _PRICE_TOKEN_RE.finditer(text):
         value = _normalize_number_token(match.group(0))
         if value is not None and value == expected:
             return True
     return False
 
 
 def _report_text(final_state: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
     """Assemble the material report text a run actually produced.
 
     Stages keep their authentic upstream role titles (``reporting.py``) so the
     independent judge can distinguish intermediate proposals (bull/bear, research
     manager, trader, risk analysts) from the final portfolio decision. The
     Portfolio Manager node writes the same string to both
     ``risk_debate_state.judge_decision`` and ``final_trade_decision``; when they
     are exactly equal after whitespace stripping, the identical content is
     included once as the final decision. Raw model text is preserved; no
     different or contrary stage is removed.
     """
     parts: list[str] = []
 
     def _add(title: str, value: Any) -> None:
         if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
             parts.append(f"## {title}\n{value.strip()}")
 
     for key, title in (
         ("market_report", "Market Analyst"),
         ("news_report", "News Analyst"),
         ("sentiment_report", "Sentiment Analyst"),
         ("fundamentals_report", "Fundamentals Analyst"),
     ):
         _add(title, final_state.get(key))
 
     debate = final_state.get("investment_debate_state")
     if isinstance(debate, dict):
         _add("Bull Researcher", debate.get("bull_history"))
         _add("Bear Researcher", debate.get("bear_history"))
         _add("Research Manager", debate.get("judge_decision"))
 
     _add("Trader", final_state.get("trader_investment_plan"))
 
     risk_judge: str | None = None
     risk = final_state.get("risk_debate_state")
     if isinstance(risk, dict):
         _add("Aggressive Analyst", risk.get("aggressive_history"))
         _add("Conservative Analyst", risk.get("conservative_history"))
         _add("Neutral Analyst", risk.get("neutral_history"))
         judge = risk.get("judge_decision")
         if isinstance(judge, str) and judge.strip():
             risk_judge = judge.strip()
 
     final = final_state.get("final_trade_decision")
     final = final.strip() if isinstance(final, str) and final.strip() else None
 
     if risk_judge is not None and final is not None and risk_judge == final:
         _add("Final Portfolio Decision", final)
     else:
         _add("Portfolio Manager", risk_judge)
         _add("Final Portfolio Decision", final)
 
     return "\n\n".join(parts)
 
 
 def _deterministic_checks(case: dict, pack, ticker: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
     """Deterministic identity/date/price/state and source-ID checks (QUALITY-001)."""
     checks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
     fs = pack.final_state if pack is not None else {}
     text = _report_text(fs)
 
     def check(name: str, passed: bool, detail: str) -> None:
         checks.append({"check": name, "passed": passed, "detail": detail})
 
     expected_company = case.get("identity", {}).get("company_name", "")
     check("instrument_identity", expected_company and expected_company.lower() in text.lower(),
           f"report references company '{expected_company}'")
     check("analysis_date", case["analysis_date"] in text,
           f"report references analysis date {case['analysis_date']}")
     check("final_decision_present", bool(fs.get("final_trade_decision")),
           "final trade decision is present in the final state")
     # Price must be supported by evidence (observed tool result or the factual
     # available corpus), never fabricated, AND the report itself must state the
     # expected close. Case metadata alone is not output evidence.
     expected_close = case["latest_close"]
     evidence_supports_price = False
     if pack is not None:
         for bucket in pack.input.data_snapshot.values():
             for res in bucket.values():
                 if isinstance(res, str) and _contains_price(res, expected_close):
                     evidence_supports_price = True
         avail = pack.input.available_sources or {}
         for source in (avail.get("market"), avail.get("verified_snapshot")):
             if isinstance(source, str) and _contains_price(source, expected_close):
                 evidence_supports_price = True
     reported_price = _contains_price(text, expected_close)
     check(
         "frozen_price_in_report",
         evidence_supports_price and reported_price,
         f"frozen latest close {expected_close:.2f} is supported by evidence and stated in the report",
     )
     source_id = case.get("source_id", "")
     check("source_id_referenced", bool(source_id) and source_id in text,
           f"report references source_id '{source_id}'")
     return checks
 
 
 def run_judge_case(
     ticker: str,
     out_dir: str | Path,
     max_calls: int | None = None,
 ) -> dict[str, Any]:
     """Judge a completed run's report with a real isolated DeepSeek evaluator.
 
     Deterministic checks are computed first. Then the real DeepSeek client
     (same model, separate role, fixed evidence and rubric) scores support,
     relevance and citations with a structured rationale. Raw response and usage
     are recorded separately. A score is never auto-assigned for nonempty text.
     """
     from research_desk.evidence import EvidencePackIO
 
     ticker = ticker.upper()
     if not os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"):
         raise RuntimeError(
             "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not set. Supply it as a host environment variable."
         )
     case = case_for(ticker)
     out = Path(out_dir)
     judged: dict[str, Any] = {"ticker": ticker, "arms": {}}
     for mode in ("baseline", "compact"):
         run_dir = out / ticker / mode / "run"
         if not run_dir.exists():
             continue
         try:
             pack = EvidencePackIO().import_pack(run_dir)
         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
             logger.warning("cannot import run for %s/%s: %s", ticker, mode, exc)
             judged["arms"][mode] = {"error": str(exc)}
             continue
         if pack.manifest.outcome != "completed" or not pack.final_state:
             judged["arms"][mode] = {
                 "outcome": pack.manifest.outcome,
                 "note": "skipped judge: run not completed",
             }
             continue
         report_text = _report_text(pack.final_state)
         deterministic = _deterministic_checks(case, pack, ticker)
         raw, score = _llm_judge(
             case,
             report_text,
             deterministic,
             available_sources=pack.input.available_sources or {},
             events=pack.events,
         )
         arm_judge_dir = out / "judge" / ticker / mode
         arm_judge_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
         _dump_json(arm_judge_dir / "raw.json", raw)
         _dump_json(arm_judge_dir / "judge.json", score)
         judged["arms"][mode] = score
     _dump_json(out / "judge" / ticker / "summary.json", judged)
     return judged
 
 
 def _observed_tools_text(events) -> str:
     """Every actual ``tool_result`` payload in the event log, in event order.
 
     ``input.data_snapshot`` is a lossy fallback projection keyed by tool
     arguments and keeps only the last output for a repeated tool name, so the
     judge reads the authoritative event log instead. Each output keeps its
     tool/source name and event sequence; an exact duplicate (same tool, same
     result) is not repeated, but different results from the same tool survive.
     """
     lines: list[str] = []
     seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
     for ev in events:
         if getattr(ev, "kind", None) != "tool_result":
             continue
         payload = getattr(ev, "payload", None) or {}
         name = payload.get("name") or "unknown"
         result = payload.get("result")
         if not isinstance(result, str) or not result.strip():
             continue
         if (name, result) in seen:
             continue
         seen.add((name, result))
         lines.append(f"## observed tool output: {name} (event {getattr(ev, 'seq', '?')})")
         lines.append(result)
     return "\n".join(lines)

 def run_aggregate(root: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
     """Compute six paired baseline/compact metrics from existing run dirs.
 
     No model is called. Completed arms are included; a missing or non-completed
     arm is recorded as such. Judge scores, when present, are attached separately.
     """
     root = Path(root)
     cases = [c for c in (root.iterdir() if root.exists() else []) if c.is_dir()]
     paired: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
     for case_dir in sorted(cases):
         ticker = case_dir.name
         arms = {}
         for mode in ("baseline", "compact"):
             summary = case_dir / mode / "summary.json"
             if not summary.exists():
                 arms[mode] = {"present": False}
                 continue
             data = json.loads(summary.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
             data["present"] = True
             judge_file = root / "judge" / ticker / mode / "judge.json"
             if judge_file.exists():
                 data["judge"] = json.loads(judge_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
             arms[mode] = data
         if not arms.get("baseline", {}).get("present") and not arms.get("compact", {}).get("present"):
             continue
         paired.append({"ticker": ticker, "baseline": arms.get("baseline"), "compact": arms.get("compact")})
     report = _aggregate_report(paired)
     _dump_json(root / "aggregate" / "summary.json", {"paired": paired})
     (root / "aggregate" / "report.md").write_text(report, encoding="utf-8")
     return {"paired": paired, "report": report}

     return arm.get(key, default)
 
 
 def _aggregate_report(paired: list[dict]) -> str:
     lines = [
         "# Baseline / Compact Aggregate (six paired metrics)",
         "",
         "Read from existing run outputs; no model calls. Judge scores are attached when present.",
         "",
         "| ticker | metric | baseline | compact | delta |",
         "|---|---|---|---|---|",
     ]
     metrics = [
         ("calls", "{:.0f}"),
         ("input_tokens", "{:.0f}"),
         ("output_tokens", "{:.0f}"),
         ("total_tokens", "{:.0f}"),
         ("wall_seconds", "{:.1f}"),
         ("outcome", "{!s}"),
     ]
     for p in paired:
         t = p["ticker"]
         for key, fmt in metrics:
             b = _arm_value(p.get("baseline"), key)
             c = _arm_value(p.get("compact"), key)
             b_s = "n/a" if b is None else fmt.format(b)
             c_s = "n/a" if c is None else fmt.format(c)
             delta = "—"
             if isinstance(b, (int, float)) and isinstance(c, (int, float)):
                 delta = _pct(b, c)
             lines.append(f"| {t} | {key} | {b_s} | {c_s} | {delta} |")
     for p in paired:
         for mode in ("baseline", "compact"):
             judge = _arm_value(p.get(mode), "judge")
             if isinstance(judge, dict) and not judge.get("error") and judge.get("support") is not None:
                 lines.append(
                     f"| {p['ticker']} | {mode} judge support | {judge['support']:.2f} | — | — |"
                 )
                 lines.append(
                     f"| {p['ticker']} | {mode} judge relevance | {judge['relevance']:.2f} | — | — |"
                 )
     return "\n".join(lines)
 
 
 def _pct(b: float, c: float) -> str:
     if b == 0:
         return "—"
     return f"{(c - b) / b * 100:+.1f}%"

 deterministic policy before writing; the approval binds the exact proposal
 version, so a changed proposal cannot ride an old approval. Re-executing an
 already-simulated proposal is a no-op (idempotence).

 in PENDING_REVIEW, and only the CLI review/execute/ledger commands touch it.

     ExecutionRecord,

 # non-tradeable (Hold / REVIEW).
 BUY_SIGNALS = {"Buy", "Overweight", "Strong Buy"}
 SELL_SIGNALS = {"Sell", "Underweight", "Reduce"}
 
 
 def _side_for_signal(signal: str) -> str:
     if signal in BUY_SIGNALS:
         return "buy"
     if signal in SELL_SIGNALS:
         return "sell"
     raise ReviewError(f"signal {signal!r} is not tradeable in v1 (Hold/REVIEW do not trade)")

     """Business rejection with a stable message; the ledger stays unchanged."""
 
 
 def _proposal_content_version(proposal: ProposalRecord) -> str:
     """Fingerprint of the proposal's tradeable inputs, independent of status."""
     return make_proposal_version(
         proposal.ticker,
         proposal.trade_date,
         proposal.signal,
         proposal.price,
         side=proposal.side,
         shares=proposal.shares,
         evidence_id=proposal.evidence_id,
     )
 
 
 def create_proposal(
     *,
     run_id: str,
     ticker: str,
     trade_date: str,
     signal: str,
     rating: str | None,
     price: float | None,
     proposal_id: str | None = None,
     evidence_id: str | None = None,
 ) -> ProposalRecord:
     """Create a PENDING_REVIEW proposal from a completed research run.
 
     Only tradeable signals become proposals: Buy-family signals are buys, Sell-
     family signals are sells (up to owned shares, enforced at execution). Hold
     and REVIEW never produce a tradeable recommendation.
     """
     if signal in ("Hold", "REVIEW"):
         raise ReviewError(
             f"signal {signal!r} is not tradeable in v1; no proposal is created "
             "(REVIEW and Hold do not trade)"
         )
     side = _side_for_signal(signal)
     pid = proposal_id or f"prop-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
     return ProposalRecord(
         proposal_id=pid,
         run_id=run_id,
         ticker=ticker,
         trade_date=trade_date,
         signal=signal,
         rating=rating,
         side=side,
         price=price,
         evidence_id=evidence_id,
         status=ProposalStatus.PENDING_REVIEW,
         proposal_version=_proposal_content_version(
             ProposalRecord(
                 proposal_id=pid,
                 run_id=run_id,
                 ticker=ticker,
                 trade_date=trade_date,
                 signal=signal,
                 rating=rating,
                 side=side,
                 price=price,
                 evidence_id=evidence_id,
             )
         ),
         created_at=utcnow_iso(),
     )
 
 
 def approve(
     proposal: ProposalRecord,
     *,
     shares: int,
     operator: str,
 ) -> ProposalRecord:
     """Approve an exact proposal version with an operator-supplied share count.
 
     The approval is bound to the proposal's *content* version, so if the run's
     material inputs (ticker/date/signal/price) later change, the old approval
     no longer matches and execution requires review.
     """
     if proposal.status == ProposalStatus.SIMULATED:
         raise ReviewError(f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} is already simulated")
     if proposal.status == ProposalStatus.REJECTED:
         raise ReviewError(f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} is rejected and cannot be approved")
     # REVIEW_REQUIRED is a safe-fail state, not a dead end: after the operator
     # reviews the current evidence, they may approve the corrected version.
     if not operator:
         raise ReviewError("approval requires an operator identity")
     if not isinstance(shares, int) or shares <= 0:
         raise ReviewError(f"shares must be a positive integer, got {shares!r}")
     if proposal.price is None or proposal.price <= 0:
         raise ReviewError(
             f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} has no evidence price; cannot approve without price"
         )
     proposal.shares = shares
     proposal.operator = operator
     proposal.status = ProposalStatus.APPROVED
     proposal.approved_at = utcnow_iso()
     proposal.approved_version = _proposal_content_version(proposal)
     return proposal

     if proposal.status == ProposalStatus.SIMULATED:
         raise ReviewError(f"proposal {proposal.proposal_id} is already simulated")
     proposal.status = ProposalStatus.REJECTED
     proposal.operator = operator
     proposal.reason = reason
     return proposal

+"""ADR-004 bounded revision contracts: terminal rejection, EPS periods, model
+version and the judge semantic-validity condition.
+
+The review tests use a Mock store so they assert the state transition itself
+(no persistence call, no ledger read) rather than a database implementation.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+import pytest

+
+from research_desk.context import build_common_grounding
+from research_desk.eval.case_registry import case_for
+from research_desk.models import ProposalStatus, utcnow_iso
+from research_desk.review import ReviewError, approve, create_proposal, execute, reject
+
+
+def _proposal(*, price: float = 100.0, proposal_id: str | None = None):
+    return create_proposal(
+        run_id="run-revision",
+        ticker="AAPL",
+        trade_date="2026-06-10",
+        signal="Buy",
+        rating="Buy",
+        price=price,
+        proposal_id=proposal_id or f"prop-revision-{utcnow_iso()[-9:]}",
+    )
+
+
+def test_rejected_execute_remains_rejected_and_cannot_be_approved():
+    """Execution cannot turn a rejection into an approvable REVIEW_REQUIRED row."""
+    store = MagicMock()
+    proposal = _proposal()
+    reject(proposal, operator="leo")
+    assert proposal.status == ProposalStatus.REJECTED
+
+    updated, execution = execute(store, proposal, operator="leo")
+
+    assert updated.status == ProposalStatus.REJECTED
+    assert execution.executed is False
+    assert execution.reason == "proposal rejected"
+    store.update_proposal_status.assert_not_called()
+    store.apply_transaction.assert_not_called()
+    store.get_ledger.assert_not_called()
+
+    with pytest.raises(ReviewError, match="rejected"):
+        approve(updated, shares=100, operator="leo")
+
+
+def test_previously_approved_then_rejected_stays_rejected_on_execute():
+    """A rejection is terminal even when an earlier approval version is present."""
+    store = MagicMock()
+    proposal = _proposal()
+    approved = approve(proposal, shares=100, operator="leo")
+    assert approved.approved_version

client = create_llm_client(
        PROVIDER,
        MODEL,
        base_url=_base_url(),

        temperature=0,
    )

    if hasattr(llm, "extra_body"):
        llm.extra_body = dict(THINKING_DISABLED_EXTRA_BODY)

    prompt = _judge_prompt(case, report_text, deterministic, available_sources, events)
    structured = llm.with_structured_output(JudgeScore, include_raw=True)
    try:
        raw_out = structured.invoke(prompt)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface judge failures visibly
        raw_failed: dict[str, Any] = {"prompt": prompt, "invoke_error": str(exc), "usage": {}}
        score: dict[str, Any] = {
            "support": None,
            "relevance": None,
            "cited_claim_count": 0,
            "supported_cited_claim_count": 0,
            "valid_citation_rate": None,
            "invalid_citation_explanations": [],
            "uncited_factual_claims": [],
            "rationale": f"judge invoke failed: {exc}",
            "error": True,
            "deterministic_checks": deterministic,
        }
        return raw_failed, score

    raw_resp = raw_out.get("raw", None)
    parsed = raw_out.get("parsed", None)
    parsing_error = raw_out.get("parsing_error", None)
    usage: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if hasattr(raw_resp, "usage_metadata"):
        usage = dict(raw_resp.usage_metadata or {}) if raw_resp.usage_metadata else {}

    # Full raw message: tool-call responses often carry content='' with the
    # answer in tool_calls, so persist the complete message, not just text.
    raw_msg_json: Any = None
    if raw_resp is not None:
        try:
            raw_msg_json = raw_resp.model_dump()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            raw_msg_json = {"content": getattr(raw_resp, "content", None)}

    if parsed is None:
        score = {
            "support": None,
            "relevance": None,
            "cited_claim_count": 0,
            "supported_cited_claim_count": 0,
            "valid_citation_rate": None,
            "invalid_citation_explanations": [],
            "uncited_factual_claims": [],
            "rationale": (
                "judge returned no parseable structured score"
                + (f": {parsing_error}" if parsing_error else "")
            ),
            "error": True,
            "parse_error": str(parsing_error) if parsing_error else None,
            "deterministic_checks": deterministic,
        }
    else:
        cited = int(parsed.cited_claim_count)
        supported = int(parsed.supported_cited_claim_count)
        valid_citation_rate = _valid_citation_rate(cited, supported)
        score = {
            "support": float(parsed.support),
            "relevance": float(parsed.relevance),
            "cited_claim_count": cited,
            "supported_cited_claim_count": supported,
            "valid_citation_rate": valid_citation_rate,
            "invalid_citation_explanations": list(parsed.invalid_citation_explanations),
            "uncited_factual_claims": list(parsed.uncited_factual_claims),
            "rationale": parsed.rationale,
            "error": False,
            "deterministic_checks": deterministic,
        }

"""ADR-004 bounded revision contracts: terminal rejection, EPS periods, model
version and the judge semantic-validity condition.

The review tests use a Mock store so they assert the state transition itself
(no persistence call, no ledger read) rather than a database implementation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import pytest
import yaml

from research_desk.context import build_common_grounding
from research_desk.eval.case_registry import case_for
from research_desk.models import ProposalStatus, utcnow_iso
from research_desk.review import ReviewError, approve, create_proposal, execute, reject


def _proposal(*, price: float = 100.0, proposal_id: str | None = None):
    return create_proposal(
        run_id="run-revision",
        ticker="AAPL",
        trade_date="2026-06-10",
        signal="Buy",
        rating="Buy",
        price=price,
        proposal_id=proposal_id or f"prop-revision-{utcnow_iso()[-9:]}",
    )


def test_rejected_execute_remains_rejected_and_cannot_be_approved():
    """Execution cannot turn a rejection into an approvable REVIEW_REQUIRED row."""
    store = MagicMock()
    proposal = _proposal()
    reject(proposal, operator="leo")
    assert proposal.status == ProposalStatus.REJECTED

    updated, execution = execute(store, proposal, operator="leo")

    assert updated.status == ProposalStatus.REJECTED
    assert execution.executed is False
    assert execution.reason == "proposal rejected"
    store.update_proposal_status.assert_not_called()
    store.apply_transaction.assert_not_called()
    store.get_ledger.assert_not_called()

    with pytest.raises(ReviewError, match="rejected"):
        approve(updated, shares=100, operator="leo")


def test_previously_approved_then_rejected_stays_rejected_on_execute():
    """A rejection is terminal even when an earlier approval version is present."""
    store = MagicMock()
    proposal = _proposal()
    approved = approve(proposal, shares=100, operator="leo")
    assert approved.approved_version
    reject(approved, operator="leo")
    assert approved.status == ProposalStatus.REJECTED

    updated, execution = execute(store, approved, operator="leo")

    assert updated.status == ProposalStatus.REJECTED
    assert execution.executed is False
    assert execution.reason == "proposal rejected"
    store.update_proposal_status.assert_not_called()
    store.apply_transaction.assert_not_called()

    with pytest.raises(ReviewError, match="rejected"):
        approve(updated, shares=100, operator="leo")


def test_common_grounding_names_eps_period_and_ttm_limit():
    grounding = build_common_grounding("AAPL", "2026-07-31", {})
    lower = grounding.lower()
    assert "quarterly eps" in lower
    assert "trailing-twelve-month (ttm)" in lower
    assert "trailing p/e" in lower
    assert "actual ttm evidence" in lower
    # No fixed stock examples or invented figures in the shared rules.
    assert "microsoft" not in lower

import time
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, model_validator

from ..config import DEFAULT_BASE_URL, DEFAULT_MODEL, DEFAULT_PROVIDER
from .case_registry import case_for
from .frozen_provider import FrozenMarketProvider

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MODEL = DEFAULT_MODEL
PROVIDER = DEFAULT_PROVIDER
OUTPUT_CAP = 1800  # provider max_tokens cap, identical for both arms


def _base_url() -> str | None:
    """Host-supplied endpoint override, otherwise the authoritative default."""
    return os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL") or DEFAULT_BASE_URL

# DeepSeek V4 is a thinking model; disable reasoning for a deterministic,
# reproducible research/judge role. Forwarded as ``extra_body`` on the model so
# it reaches the provider request payload.
THINKING_DISABLED_EXTRA_BODY = {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}


def _graph_config(home: Path, base_url: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Build the evaluation graph config from the real DEFAULT_CONFIG.

    The upstream graph treats the supplied dict as complete, so we start from a
    deep copy of ``DEFAULT_CONFIG`` (which declares ``data_cache_dir``,
    ``results_dir`` and ``memory_log_path``) and then override the explicit
    model/settings. The path fields are pointed inside the arm's isolated home
    so both arms' effective settings are identical and each run stays isolated.
    """
    from copy import deepcopy

    from tradingagents.default_config import DEFAULT_CONFIG

    cfg = deepcopy(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    cfg.update(
        {
            "llm_provider": PROVIDER,
            "quick_think_llm": MODEL,
            "deep_think_llm": MODEL,
            "max_tokens": OUTPUT_CAP,
            "temperature": 0,
            "llm_max_retries": 2,

1: # Verification constraints
2: 
3: All fit criteria have named evidence in the trace matrix. All zero-tolerance invariants need a negative example that would fail if the invariant were removed. Tests refer to requirement or AT identifiers. Tests should assert externally meaningful behavior instead of restating a function's implementation.
4: 
5: Tier1 is structural: package/import health, ownership boundaries, effective permissions, requirement schema, lint, type and dependency checks. Tier2 is regression: run all original tests/ plus test/offline/ after each completed implementation round. Tier3 is behavioral: replay equivalence, policy safety, request-budget enforcement and fixed-corpus factual quality. Passing one tier does not substitute for another.
6: 
7: Offline fixture evidence is deliberately constructed and labeled. Live evidence comes only from actual requests. Fixed evaluation inputs contain six real equity cases, with AAPL/MSFT used for development and four other companies reserved before tuning. Both arms preserve graph roles and use identical model settings. Record retries and failed cases. Report actual provider input/output usage; judge calls remain separate.
8:

1: # TradingAgents Research Desk 项目方案
2: 
3: 状态：供主线程自主采纳的实施方案；应用实现尚未开始。用户已授权教学评估实验中的模拟学生决策，所有此类记录标为leo。指标为验收目标，没有已完成实验结果。
4: 
5: ## 一、交付范围
6: 
7: 在现有 TradingAgents 上交付完整流程：**运行研究 → 保存证据包 → 对照研究配置 → 审阅建议 → 确定性策略校验 → 更新模拟账本**。
8: 
9: 第一版使用 CLI 和 HTML/Markdown 报告。只支持 market/news 分析员、US 股票和英语研究报告，仍沿用上游 bull/bear、research manager、trader、risk 与 portfolio manager 流程。完成可演示的纵向切片后再考虑界面美化，不接真实交易。
10: 
11: 这三功能是可实现的起始范围。课程按 N 名组员提出新增需求，当前实际人数未知；后续按真实人数分配有意义的切片，不能把机械拆分当作个人贡献。
12: 
13: ## 二、基线与只读核对结果
14: 
15: 建议固定官方 [TradingAgents v0.4.0](https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents/tree/v0.4.0)，不用滚动 main。已通过 `git ls-remote --tags` 确认标签存在，并下载只读源码到 `/private/tmp/cs5351-tradingagents-v0.4.0`。包版本为0.4.0，要求Python>=3.10。
16: 
17: v0.4.0于2026-08-31发布，包含日期一致性与恢复修复。它是正式标签，但刚发布，不能声称已长期稳定验证；开始实施时跑一次已有离线测试建立本地基线。[官方变更记录](https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents/blob/v0.4.0/CHANGELOG.md)
18: 
19: 已核对的实际接口：
20: 
21: - `TradingAgentsGraph(selected_analysts, debug, config, callbacks)`。

+"""Permission configuration check (part of Gate 2).
+
+Validates the effective OpenCode permission configuration and the reviewable
+``.opencode/permissions.jsonc`` manifest agree, the required rule files are
+loaded, and each concrete role (plan / build / verify) cannot step outside its
+approved boundary.
+
+OpenCode does not load ``permissions.jsonc``; it is only a reviewable
+projection. The authoritative file is the effective root ``opencode.json``
+(candidate becomes authoritative only after installation). This check therefore
+reads the effective config and verifies the manifest against it.
+
+Evaluation model
+----------------
+- Path tools (read / edit / glob / grep / bash / task / skill) can carry
+  granular object rules. A rule object maps a glob pattern to an action
+  (allow / ask / deny); the last matching pattern wins, and agent rules are
+  evaluated after global rules so they take precedence.
+- Wildcards follow OpenCode's documented simple semantics: ``*`` matches zero
+  or more of any character, ``?`` matches exactly one, everything else is
+  literal.
+
+The boundary assertions are the enforcement: if a protected path ever resolves
+to a non-deny ``edit`` (or a forbidden path resolves to allow), the check
+reports it, so a misconfigured build role that can edit approvals or a verify
+role that can edit application code is detected.
+
+Default mode (no ``--config``) inspects the actually installed root config and
+fails until the approved candidate is installed. ``--config PATH`` enables the
+focused candidate check used during preparation.
+
+This is coding-tool enforcement, not an OS sandbox: it does not claim to stop
+arbitrary malicious code inside approved tests.

4: 
5: Tier1 is structural: package/import health, ownership boundaries, effective permissions, requirement schema, lint, type and dependency checks. Tier2 is regression: run all original tests/ plus test/offline/ after each completed implementation round. Tier3 is behavioral: replay equivalence, policy safety, request-budget enforcement and fixed-corpus factual quality. Passing one tier does not substitute for another.
6:

Fixed evaluation inputs contain six real equity cases, with AAPL/MSFT used for development and four other companies reserved before tuning.  # ADR-001: Extend the existing graph through application-owned seams
 
 Status: accepted by leo, 2026-08-31. Requirements: FR-001 through FR-003, INV-001, INV-002. The concrete plan and tests were approved at 12:05:17.791955 UTC before OpenCode's first implementation event at 12:06:32.695 UTC.
 
 ## Context and alternatives
 
 TradingAgents v0.4.0 already provides multi-agent research, structured decisions, date-aware memory, checkpointing and price validation. The missing product workflow is portable evidence followed by explicit approval and paper execution. A complete graph rewrite would discard tested domain behavior and make the optimization baseline incomparable. Editing every upstream prompt and tool would distribute application-specific policy across many owners. A narrow application extension keeps the experimental boundary visible.
 
 Candidate A modifies the entire graph and shared vendors. Candidate B subclasses/composes the existing graph and implements policy outside it. Candidate C builds a small new agent demo. The evaluation table selects B because it preserves genuine AI integration while keeping deterministic authority isolated. The original graph's full selected role sequence is retained in both experimental arms.
 
 ## Context layers and assembly
 
 Layer1 identifies the instrument and analysis cutoff. Layer2 states standing constraints: use available evidence, retain source identity, distinguish unknown facts and keep execution advisory. Layer3 supplies frozen market/history/news knowledge. Layer4 holds current discussion and retrieved past context. Layer5 preserves resumable structured state. Layer6 gives the current agent task and expected output.
 
 The assembly order is eligibility filtering, duplicate removal in compact mode, prioritization, budget accounting, compaction and final constraint reinjection. Baseline preserves original substantive prompt input. Compact can remove repeated paragraphs or shorten older discussion, while retaining symbol, date, price evidence, source IDs and current task. It also requests concise role output to reduce repeated prose passed to later agents. Fresh six-case runs have little past memory, so compact must apply to actual per-agent messages; changing only a memory string would leave the dominant token cost unchanged.
 
 The call budget is configured for the experiment. Per-call maximum output bounds use the provider's existing max_tokens contract. Character estimates may guide context assembly but never replace provider-reported token usage. The model adapter checks before starting a request; a structured-output retry cannot create an extra request after the budget is exhausted. Critical constraints are re-injected after compaction. Factual quality is evaluated independently of brevity.
 
 ## Consequences and reopening conditions
 
 Evidence packs contain prompts and responses and are larger than ordinary reports. Replay is fast because it reconstructs captured state; controlled reruns call the model and remain stochastic. The frozen provider must answer valid parameter variations from data, because an exact tool-transcript lookup would bias the comparison when compact changes tool arguments.
 
 The approval boundary stays outside all model tools. The extension retains responsibility for current-ledger checks even if upstream research changes. Reopen this ADR if an upstream public interface cannot expose a material external read, if multiuser concurrency is added, or if compact cannot satisfy factual constraints without discarding agent roles. No such need justifies silently replacing the baseline.
 
 ## Affected paths
 
 The accepted application scope includes `src/research_desk/config.py`, `graph_adapter.py`, `budget.py`, `evidence.py`, `context.py`, `models.py`, `replay.py`, `report.py`, `cli.py` and the application-owned `src/research_desk/eval/` adapters. `pyproject.toml` exposes the installed extension. These paths implement the already approved evidence, research-context and runtime-budget boundaries. The deterministic approval and ledger changes are specified more precisely in ADR-002. No upstream vendor implementation is replaced.
 
 ## Development correction within the accepted boundary
 
 The initial two-case experiment established token reduction but failed citation acceptance. The initial past_context alone did not reach downstream roles, so the common evidence policy is now attached to every real model request in both arms through a plain delegate. Tool binding and structured output compose a LangChain Runnable preprocessor with the real client; they preserve the real returned messages and tool-call identities. Baseline substantive history stays unchanged. Compact retains its declared concise-output target. Runtime prompt version0.1.1 records this source-grounding correction, and the0.1.0 snapshot and original development outputs remain available. The rubric and thresholds are unchanged; the four reserved cases remain unopened until development is frozen.
+
+
+## Current context boundary
+
+ADR-004 adds a 96,000-unit whole-input cap and a 72,000-unit compaction trigger. Units are a conservative UTF-8 byte bound with message/tool-call overhead. These values are defined once in ResearchDeskSettings defaults. The delegate preserves mandatory evidence and tool-message pairs. If required input cannot fit, it stops before model invocation. Each call records the before/after estimate; cost results continue to use provider tokens.

 def _observed_tools_text(events) -> str:
     """Every actual ``tool_result`` payload in the event log, in event order.
 
     ``input.data_snapshot`` is a lossy fallback projection keyed by tool
     arguments and keeps only the last output for a repeated tool name, so the
     judge reads the authoritative event log instead. Each output keeps its
     tool/source name and event sequence; an exact duplicate (same tool, same
     result) is not repeated, but different results from the same tool survive.
     """
     lines: list[str] = []
     seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
     for ev in events:
         if getattr(ev, "kind", None) != "tool_result":
             continue
         payload = getattr(ev, "payload", None) or {}
         name = payload.get("name") or "unknown"
         result = payload.get("result")
         if not isinstance(result, str) or not result.strip():
             continue
         if (name, result) in seen:
             continue
         seen.add((name, result))
         lines.append(f"## observed tool output: {name} (event {getattr(ev, 'seq', '?')})")
         lines.append(result)
     return "\n".join(lines)

 def _valid_citation_rate(cited: int, supported: int) -> float | None:
     """Supported-cited fraction; a zero denominator is NOT an automatic pass."""

     ``semantic_valid`` defaults to ``False`` when a legacy or incomplete judge
     response omits it, so absence can never be read as a pass. Any recorded
     semantic error also forces it to ``False`` regardless of citation counts.

     relevance: float = Field(..., ge=0, le=1)

 def run_aggregate(root: str | Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
     """Compute six paired baseline/compact metrics from existing run dirs.
 
     No model is called. Completed arms are included; a missing or non-completed
     arm is recorded as such. Judge scores, when present, are attached separately.
     """
     root = Path(root)
     cases = [c for c in (root.iterdir() if root.exists() else []) if c.is_dir()]
     paired: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
     for case_dir in sorted(cases):
         ticker = case_dir.name
         arms = {}
         for mode in ("baseline", "compact"):
             summary = case_dir / mode / "summary.json"
             if not summary.exists():
                 arms[mode] = {"present": False}
                 continue
             data = json.loads(summary.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
             data["present"] = True
             judge_file = root / "judge" / ticker / mode / "judge.json"
             if judge_file.exists():
                 data["judge"] = json.loads(judge_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
             arms[mode] = data
         if not arms.get("baseline", {}).get("present") and not arms.get("compact", {}).get("present"):
             continue
         paired.append({"ticker": ticker, "baseline": arms.get("baseline"), "compact": arms.get("compact")})
     report = _aggregate_report(paired)
     _dump_json(root / "aggregate" / "summary.json", {"paired": paired})
     (root / "aggregate" / "report.md").write_text(report, encoding="utf-8")
     return {"paired": paired, "report": report}
 
 
 def _arm_value(arm: dict | None, key: str, default=None):
     if arm is None or not arm.get("present"):
         return default
     return arm.get(key, default)
 
 
 def _aggregate_report(paired: list[dict]) -> str:
     lines = [
         "# Baseline / Compact Aggregate (six paired metrics)",
         "",
         "Read from existing run outputs; no model calls. Judge scores are attached when present.",
         "",
         "| ticker | metric | baseline | compact | delta |",
         "|---|---|---|---|---|",
     ]
     metrics = [
         ("calls", "{:.0f}"),
         ("input_tokens", "{:.0f}"),
         ("output_tokens", "{:.0f}"),
         ("total_tokens", "{:.0f}"),
         ("wall_seconds", "{:.1f}"),
         ("outcome", "{!s}"),
     ]
     for p in paired:
         t = p["ticker"]
         for key, fmt in metrics:
             b = _arm_value(p.get("baseline"), key)
             c = _arm_value(p.get("compact"), key)
             b_s = "n/a" if b is None else fmt.format(b)
             c_s = "n/a" if c is None else fmt.format(c)
             delta = "—"
             if isinstance(b, (int, float)) and isinstance(c, (int, float)):
                 delta = _pct(b, c)
             lines.append(f"| {t} | {key} | {b_s} | {c_s} | {delta} |")
     for p in paired:
         for mode in ("baseline", "compact"):
             judge = _arm_value(p.get(mode), "judge")
             if isinstance(judge, dict) and not judge.get("error") and judge.get("support") is not None:
                 lines.append(
                     f"| {p['ticker']} | {mode} judge support | {judge['support']:.2f} | — | — |"
                 )
                 lines.append(
                     f"| {p['ticker']} | {mode} judge relevance | {judge['relevance']:.2f} | — | — |"
                 )
     return "\n".join(lines)
 
 
 def _pct(b: float, c: float) -> str:
     if b == 0:
         return "—"
     return f"{(c - b) / b * 100:+.1f}%"

+            _provenance(prov, current, label, "run", failures)
+            _provenance(jprov, current, label, "judge", failures)

+            if config.get("llm_provider") != prov.get("provider"):

+            if config.get("quick_think_llm") != prov.get("model") or config.get("deep_think_llm") != prov.get("model"):

+            if config.get("quick_think_llm") != DEFAULT_MODEL or config.get("deep_think_llm") != DEFAULT_MODEL:

+            try:

+        ):

+        if _settings(baseline["config"]) != _settings(compact["config"]):
+            failures.append(f"{ticker}: settings differ across arms")
+        if (baseline["jprov"].get("model"), baseline["jprov"].get("provider")) != (
+            compact["jprov"].get("model"), compact["jprov"].get("provider")
+        ):
+            failures.append(f"{ticker}: judge model/provider differ across arms")
+        if (baseline["prov"].get("model"), baseline["prov"].get("provider")) != (
+            baseline["jprov"].get("model"), baseline["jprov"].get("provider")
+        ):
+            failures.append(f"{ticker}: judge provenance does not match run provenance")
+        metrics["cases"][ticker] = {
+            "baseline_tokens": baseline["summary"].get("total_tokens"),
+            "compact_tokens": compact["summary"].get("total_tokens"),
+            "baseline_wall_seconds": baseline["summary"].get("wall_seconds"),
+            "compact_wall_seconds": compact["summary"].get("wall_seconds"),
+            "baseline_quality": _quality(baseline["judge"]),
+            "compact_quality": _quality(compact["judge"]),
+        }
+
+    paired = [
+        m for m in metrics["cases"].values()
+        if None not in (
+            m["baseline_tokens"], m["compact_tokens"], m["baseline_wall_seconds"],
+            m["compact_wall_seconds"], m["baseline_quality"], m["compact_quality"],
+        )
+    ]
+    if paired:
+        baseline_tokens = sum(m["baseline_tokens"] for m in paired)
+        compact_tokens = sum(m["compact_tokens"] for m in paired)
+        baseline_wall = sum(m["baseline_wall_seconds"] for m in paired)
+        compact_wall = sum(m["compact_wall_seconds"] for m in paired)
+        reduction = 1 - compact_tokens / baseline_tokens if baseline_tokens > 0 else None
+        ratio = compact_wall / baseline_wall if baseline_wall > 0 else None
+        baseline_quality = sum(m["baseline_quality"] for m in paired) / len(paired)
+        compact_quality = sum(m["compact_quality"] for m in paired) / len(paired)
+        drop = baseline_quality - compact_quality
+        metrics["aggregate"] = {
+            "token_reduction": reduction,
+            "mean_quality_baseline": baseline_quality,
+            "mean_quality_compact": compact_quality,
+            "mean_quality_drop": drop,
+            "wall_ratio": ratio,
+        }
+        metrics["should_targets"] = {
+            "token_reduction": {"value": reduction, "target": f">={COST_MIN}", "passed": reduction is not None and reduction >= COST_MIN},
+            "mean_quality_drop": {"value": drop, "target": f"<={QUALITY_DROP_MAX}", "passed": drop <= QUALITY_DROP_MAX},
+            "wall_ratio": {"value": ratio, "target": f"<={WALL_MAX}", "passed": ratio is not None and ratio <= WALL_MAX},
+        }
+        for name, target in metrics["should_targets"].items():
+            status = "PASS" if target["passed"] else "FAIL"
+            checks.append(f"RELEASE_SHOULD {name}={target['value']} target {target['target']} {status}")
+            if not target["passed"] and name != "mean_quality_drop":
+                warnings.append(f"Should target missed: {name}={target['value']} target {target['target']}")
+        if drop > QUALITY_DROP_MAX:
+            failures.append(f"quality retention failed: mean quality drop {drop:.4f} > {QUALITY_DROP_MAX}")
+
+    return {
+        "failures": failures,
+        "checks": checks,
+        "warnings": warnings,
+        "metrics": metrics,
+        "source_fingerprint": current,
+    }

 """Offline replay of a complete evidence pack.
 
 Replay imports a saved pack (directory or ZIP), validates that it is complete,
 then rebuilds the deterministic outputs with **zero external calls**: the
 report tree from the captured final state, the structured signal via the same
 deterministic heuristic the graph uses, and the policy verdict for the pack's
 proposal against a supplied ledger.
 
 This is the *offline reproduction* path. It is deliberately distinct from a
 controlled LLM rerun (``data_mode="frozen"`` in the runner), which re-executes
 the real graph over frozen evidence. Replay never starts an LLM request.
 """
 
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 from dataclasses import dataclass, field
 from pathlib import Path
 
 from tradingagents.graph.signal_processing import SignalProcessor
 from tradingagents.reporting import write_report_tree
 
 from .evidence import EvidencePackIO
 from .models import EvidencePack
 from .policy import PolicyVerdict, evaluate_buy, evaluate_sell, policy_bounds
+from .report import apply_research_identity_header, render_research_identity
 
 
 @dataclass
 class ReplayResult:
     pack: EvidencePack
     signal: str | None = None
     report_files: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
     policy_verdict: PolicyVerdict | None = None
     policy_bounds: dict | None = None
     external_calls: int = 0  # always 0 for offline replay
     incomplete: bool = False
     error: str | None = None
 
 
 class ReplayEngine:
     """Rebuilds reports, signal and policy outputs from a complete evidence pack."""
 
     def __init__(self, io: EvidencePackIO | None = None):
         self.io = io or EvidencePackIO()
         # Deterministic heuristic; the graph constructs it the same way.
         self._signal_processor = SignalProcessor()
 
     def load(self, source: str | Path) -> EvidencePack:
         return self.io.import_pack(source)
 
     def replay(
         self,
         source: str | Path | EvidencePack,
         out_dir: str | Path,
         ledger=None,
     ) -> ReplayResult:
         """Rebuild the pack's outputs under ``out_dir`` with no network calls."""
         pack = source if isinstance(source, EvidencePack) else self.load(source)
         result = ReplayResult(pack=pack)
 
         if pack.manifest.outcome == "completed" and not pack.final_state:
             result.incomplete = True
             result.error = "pack claims completion but has no final_state"
             return result
 
         signal = None
         if pack.final_state.get("final_trade_decision"):
             signal = self._signal_processor.process_signal(
                 pack.final_state["final_trade_decision"]
             )
         result.signal = signal
 
         out = Path(out_dir)
         try:
             complete = write_report_tree(pack.final_state, pack.manifest.ticker, out)
+            apply_research_identity_header(complete, render_research_identity(pack))
             result.report_files = [str(p) for p in out.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
             if complete not in result.report_files:
                 result.report_files.append(str(complete))
         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - report rebuild is best-effort
             result.error = f"report rebuild failed: {exc}"
 
         if ledger is not None and pack.proposal is not None:
             prop = pack.proposal
             result.policy_bounds = policy_bounds(ledger, prop.ticker, prop.price)
             if prop.shares is not None and prop.price is not None:
                 verdict = (
                     evaluate_sell(ledger, prop.ticker, prop.shares, prop.price)
                     if prop.side == "sell"
                     else evaluate_buy(ledger, prop.ticker, prop.shares, prop.price)
                 )
                 result.policy_verdict = verdict
             else:
                 result.policy_verdict = PolicyVerdict(
                     allowed=False,
                     checks=[
                         {
                             "check": "proposal_material",
                             "passed": False,
                             "detail": "proposal missing operator shares (supplied at approval); "
                             "policy bounds are reported instead",
                         }
                     ],
                 )
 
         return result

     """Table rendering for a baseline/compact comparison (FR-003)."""
     lines = [
         "# Baseline / Compact Comparison",
         "",
         "Same graph, same frozen evidence; only the context assembly differs.",
         "",
         "| metric | baseline | compact | delta |",
         "|---|---|---|---|",
     ]
 
     def row(name: str, b, c, fmt="{:.1f}") -> str:
         return f"| {name} | {fmt.format(b)} | {fmt.format(c)} | {_delta(b, c)} |"
 
     lines.append(row("LLM calls", baseline["calls"], compact["calls"], "{:.0f}"))
     lines.append(row("input tokens", baseline["input_tokens"], compact["input_tokens"]))
     lines.append(row("output tokens", baseline["output_tokens"], compact["output_tokens"]))
     lines.append(row("total tokens", baseline["total_tokens"], compact["total_tokens"]))
     lines.append(row("wall time (s)", baseline["wall_seconds"], compact["wall_seconds"]))
     lines.append(f"| stop reason | {baseline['stop_reason']} | {compact['stop_reason']} | — |")
     lines.append(f"| context chars | {baseline['context_chars']} | {compact['context_chars']} | {_delta(baseline['context_chars'], compact['context_chars'])} |")
     lines.append(f"| signal | {baseline['signal'] or 'n/a'} | {compact['signal'] or 'n/a'} | — |")
     return "\n".join(lines)
 
 
 def _delta(b: float, c: float) -> str:
     if b == 0:
         return "—"
     pct = (c - b) / b * 100
     return f"{pct:+.1f}%"

+"""Deterministic research-report identity contract (ADR-004).
+
+The header is rendered only from the actual ``EvidencePack``. These tests use
+two different actual-shaped fixture packs to prove the output is generic (legal
+identity and evidence price per pack), that unknown facts stay unavailable, and
+that the exported report, replay output, run summary and judge input all share
+the same contract without changing raw ``final_state`` text.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+
+from research_desk.report import (
+    apply_research_identity_header,
+    render_research_identity,
+    render_run_report,
+)
+from research_desk.replay import ReplayEngine
+from test.fixtures.fixture_packs import build_pack, stock_data_csv
+from tradingagents.reporting import write_report_tree
+
+
+def _actual_pack(
+    *,
+    ticker: str,
+    company: str,
+    close: float,
+    source_id: str,
+    analysis_date: str,
+    as_of: str,
+):
+    dates = ["2026-06-01", "2026-06-10"]
+    pack = build_pack(
+        run_id=f"run-{ticker.lower()}-contract",
+        ticker=ticker,
+        trade_date=analysis_date,
+        signal="Buy",
+        final_decision="**Rating**: Buy\n\n**Executive Summary**: Buy modest size.",
+        closes=[close - 1.0, close],
+        dates=dates,
+        with_proposal=False,
+    )
+    pack.input = pack.input.model_copy(
+        update={
+            "identity": {
+                "company_name": company,
+                "sector": "Technology",
+                "industry": "Test Industry",
+            },
+            "available_sources": {
+                "identity": {
+                    "company_name": company,
+                    "sector": "Technology",
+                    "industry": "Test Industry",
+                },
+                "latest_close": close,
+                "as_of": as_of,
+                "source_id": source_id,
+                "market_source_id": f"market-{ticker.lower()}",
+                "market": stock_data_csv(ticker, [close - 1.0, close], dates),
+                "verified_snapshot": f"last_close: {close:.2f}",
+            },
+        }
+    )
+    return pack
+
+
+def test_identity_header_is_generic_across_two_actual_packs():
+    aapl = _actual_pack(
+        ticker="AAPL",
+        company="Apple Inc.",
+        close=308.91,
+        source_id="src-aapl",
+        analysis_date="2026-07-31",
+        as_of="2026-07-31",
+    )
+    msft = _actual_pack(
+        ticker="MSFT",
+        company="Microsoft Corporation",
+        close=451.10,
+        source_id="src-msft",
+        analysis_date="2026-07-30",
+        as_of="2026-07-30",
+    )
+
+    aapl_header = render_research_identity(aapl)
+    assert "Apple Inc." in aapl_header
+    assert "AAPL" in aapl_header
+    assert "2026-07-31" in aapl_header
+    assert "308.91" in aapl_header
+    assert "market-aapl" in aapl_header
+    assert "src-aapl" in aapl_header
+    assert "Microsoft Corporation" not in aapl_header
+    assert "451.10" not in aapl_header
+
+    msft_header = render_research_identity(msft)
+    assert "Microsoft Corporation" in msft_header
+    assert "MSFT" in msft_header
+    assert "2026-07-30" in msft_header
+    assert "451.10" in msft_header
+    assert "market-msft" in msft_header
+    assert "src-msft" in msft_header
+    assert "Apple Inc." not in msft_header
+    assert "308.91" not in msft_header
+
+
+def test_missing_identity_and_price_stay_explicitly_unavailable():
+    pack = build_pack(
+        run_id="run-missing-contract",
+        ticker="AAPL",
+        trade_date="2026-07-31",
+        signal="Buy",
+        final_decision="**Rating**: Buy",
+        closes=[99.0, 100.0],
+        dates=["2026-06-01", "2026-06-10"],
+        with_proposal=False,
+    )
+    pack.input = pack.input.model_copy(
+        update={"identity": {}, "available_sources": {}, "data_snapshot": {}}
+    )
+
+    header = render_research_identity(pack)
+    assert "- Company (legal identity): unavailable" in header
+    assert "- Evidence latest close: unavailable" in header
+    assert "- Official earnings source: unavailable" in header
+    assert "- Company (legal identity): AAPL" not in header
+    assert "market-aapl" not in header
+
+
+def test_exported_complete_report_gets_header_and_keeps_raw_text(tmp_path):
+    pack = _actual_pack(
+        ticker="AAPL",
+        company="Apple Inc.",
+        close=308.91,
+        source_id="src-aapl",
+        analysis_date="2026-07-31",
+        as_of="2026-07-31",
+    )
+    raw_market = pack.final_state["market_report"]
+    original_state = copy.deepcopy(pack.final_state)
+
+    out = tmp_path / "report"
+    complete = write_report_tree(pack.final_state, pack.manifest.ticker, out)
+    apply_research_identity_header(complete, render_research_identity(pack))
+
+    text = complete.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert text.startswith("# Research Desk Analysis Report")
+    assert "Apple Inc." in text
+    assert "308.91" in text
+    assert raw_market in text  # generated model text is unchanged
+    assert pack.final_state == original_state
+
+    # Re-applying must replace the header, not duplicate it.
+    apply_research_identity_header(complete, render_research_identity(pack))
+    assert text.count("# Research Desk Analysis Report") == 1
+    assert complete.read_text(encoding="utf-8").count("# Research Desk Analysis Report") == 1
+
+
+def test_replay_output_uses_same_contract_without_duplicate_header(tmp_path):
+    pack = _actual_pack(
+        ticker="MSFT",
+        company="Microsoft Corporation",
+        close=451.10,
+        source_id="src-msft",
+        analysis_date="2026-07-30",
+        as_of="2026-07-30",
+    )
+    raw_market = pack.final_state["market_report"]
+    original_state = copy.deepcopy(pack.final_state)
+
+    out = tmp_path / "replay"
+    ReplayEngine().replay(pack, out)
+    complete = out / "complete_report.md"
+    text = complete.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert text.startswith("# Research Desk Analysis Report")
+    assert "Microsoft Corporation" in text
+    assert "451.10" in text
+    assert raw_market in text
+    assert pack.final_state == original_state
+
+    ReplayEngine().replay(pack, out)
+    rebuilt = complete.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert rebuilt.count("# Research Desk Analysis Report") == 1
+
+
+def test_run_summary_and_judge_input_share_the_contract():
+    from research_desk.eval.live import _report_text, _report_text_with_identity
+
+    pack = _actual_pack(
+        ticker="AAPL",
+        company="Apple Inc.",
+        close=308.91,
+        source_id="src-aapl",
+        analysis_date="2026-07-31",
+        as_of="2026-07-31",
+    )
+
+    summary = render_run_report(pack)
+    assert summary.startswith("# Research Desk Analysis Report")
+    assert "Apple Inc." in summary
+    assert "308.91" in summary
+
+    raw = _report_text(pack.final_state)
+    judged = _report_text_with_identity(pack)
+    assert judged.startswith("# Research Desk Analysis Report")
+    assert "Apple Inc." in judged
+    assert "308.91" in judged
+    assert raw in judged  # every generated role paragraph is preserved
+
+
+def test_judge_rubric_says_header_does_not_excuse_contradictions():
+    from research_desk.eval.live import _judge_prompt
+
+    prompt = _judge_prompt(
+        {
+            "ticker": "AAPL",
+            "analysis_date": "2026-07-31",
+            "latest_close": 308.91,
+            "source_id": "src-aapl",
+            "notes": [],
+        },
+        "report text",
+        [],
+        available_sources={},
+        events=[],
+    )
+    assert "A correct header does NOT excuse a contradictory price or identity" in prompt
+    assert "wrong earnings period or unit" in prompt

class ReplayResult:
    pack: EvidencePack
    signal: str | None = None
    report_files: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    policy_verdict: PolicyVerdict | None = None
    policy_bounds: dict | None = None
    external_calls: int = 0  # always 0 for offline replay
    incomplete: bool = False
    error: str | None = None


class ReplayEngine:
    """Rebuilds reports, signal and policy outputs from a complete evidence pack."""

    def __init__(self, io: EvidencePackIO | None = None):
        self.io = io or EvidencePackIO()
        # Deterministic heuristic; the graph constructs it the same way.
        self._signal_processor = SignalProcessor()

    def load(self, source: str | Path) -> EvidencePack:
        return self.io.import_pack(source)

    def replay(
        self,
        source: str | Path | EvidencePack,
        out_dir: str | Path,
        ledger=None,
    ) -> ReplayResult:
        """Rebuild the pack's outputs under ``out_dir`` with no network calls."""
        pack = source if isinstance(source, EvidencePack) else self.load(source)
        result = ReplayResult(pack=pack)

        if pack.manifest.outcome == "completed" and not pack.final_state:
            result.incomplete = True
            result.error = "pack claims completion but has no final_state"
            return result

        signal = None
        if pack.final_state.get("final_trade_decision"):
            signal = self._signal_processor.process_signal(
                pack.final_state["final_trade_decision"]
            )
        result.signal = signal

        out = Path(out_dir)
        try:
            complete = write_report_tree(pack.final_state, pack.manifest.ticker, out)
            result.report_files = [str(p) for p in out.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
            if complete not in result.report_files:
                result.report_files.append(str(complete))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - report rebuild is best-effort
            result.error = f"report rebuild failed: {exc}"

        if ledger is not None and pack.proposal is not None:
            prop = pack.proposal
            result.policy_bounds = policy_bounds(ledger, prop.ticker, prop.price)
            if prop.shares is not None and prop.price is not None:
                verdict = (
                    evaluate_sell(ledger, prop.ticker, prop.shares, prop.price)
                    if prop.side == "sell"
                    else evaluate_buy(ledger, prop.ticker, prop.shares, prop.price)
                )
                result.policy_verdict = verdict
            else:
                result.policy_verdict = PolicyVerdict(
                    allowed=False,
                    checks=[
                        {
                            "check": "proposal_material",
                            "passed": False,
                            "detail": "proposal missing operator shares (supplied at approval); "
                            "policy bounds are reported instead",
                        }
                    ],
                )

        return result

def test_incomplete_pack_fails_clearly(aapl_pack, tmp_path):
    """AT-01: a deleted required record is reported, not silently replayed."""
    missing_dir = tmp_path / "missing-final-state"
    shutil.copytree("test/fixtures/packs/aapl_buy_complete", missing_dir)
    (missing_dir / "final_state.json").unlink()
    engine = ReplayEngine()
    with pytest.raises(EvidencePackError, match="missing required files"):
        engine.load(missing_dir)


def test_empty_final_state_for_completed_run_rejected(tmp_path):
    """A pack claiming completion with an empty final state cannot replay."""
    import shutil

    d = tmp_path / "empty-state"
    shutil.copytree("test/fixtures/packs/aapl_buy_complete", d)
    (d / "final_state.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    engine = ReplayEngine()
    with pytest.raises(EvidencePackError, match="empty final_state"):
        engine.load(d)


def test_replay_reproduces_signal_and_policy_inprocess(aapl_pack, tmp_path):
    """AT-01: in-process replay matches the recorded signal and policy verdict."""
    engine = ReplayEngine()
    out_dir = tmp_path / "reports"
    ledger = LedgerState(cash=100000.0)
    result = engine.replay(aapl_pack, out_dir, ledger=ledger)
    assert result.signal == aapl_pack.manifest.signal == "Buy"
    assert result.policy_bounds is not None
    assert result.policy_bounds["max_by_cap"] == 100  # 10% cap reproduced offline
    assert result.policy_bounds["price_present"] is True
    assert (out_dir / "complete_report.md").exists()


def test_replay_hold_and_review_produce_no_tradeable_proposal(fixture_pack, tmp_path):
    """Hold and REVIEW signals never replay into a tradeable proposal (policy gate)."""
    engine = ReplayEngine()
    out_dir = tmp_path / "reports"
    ledger = LedgerState(cash=100000.0)
    result = engine.replay(fixture_pack, out_dir, ledger=ledger)
    if fixture_pack.manifest.signal in ("Hold", "REVIEW"):
        assert fixture_pack.proposal is None
        assert result.policy_verdict is None
    else:
        assert result.policy_verdict is not None

        },

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from .models import EvidencePack, LedgerState, ProposalRecord

RESEARCH_IDENTITY_TITLE = "# Research Desk Analysis Report"


def _identity_value(identity: dict, key: str) -> str:
    value = identity.get(key)
    return value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) else ""


def render_research_identity(pack: EvidencePack) -> str:
    """Render the deterministic identity/date/evidence-price report contract.

    Every value comes from the actual ``EvidencePack``: the legal company name
    from ``input.identity`` or the actual ``available_sources.identity``, the
    ticker/date from the manifest, the close from ``price_from_evidence`` over
    the pack's own snapshot/corpus, and source IDs from the actual registry.
    Missing facts are rendered as explicitly unavailable; no case registry is
    imported and no identity or price is invented.
    """
    manifest = pack.manifest
    identity = dict(pack.input.identity or {})
    sources = dict(pack.input.available_sources or {})
    source_identity = dict(sources.get("identity") or {})
    merged_identity = {
        **source_identity,
        **{key: value for key, value in identity.items() if value},
    }
    company = _identity_value(merged_identity, "company_name")
    ticker = (manifest.ticker or "").upper()
    trade_date = manifest.trade_date or ""

    price = None
    try:
        from .graph_adapter import price_from_evidence

        price = price_from_evidence(
            pack.input.data_snapshot or {},
            ticker,
            available_sources=sources,
        )
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - identity rendering must stay best-effort
        price = None
    if price is None:
        candidate = sources.get("latest_close")
        if isinstance(candidate, (int, float)):
            price = float(candidate)

    source_id = _identity_value(sources, "source_id")
    market_id = _identity_value(sources, "market_source_id")
    as_of = _identity_value(sources, "as_of")

    lines = [RESEARCH_IDENTITY_TITLE, ""]
    lines.append(f"- Company (legal identity): {company or 'unavailable'}")
    lines.append(f"- Ticker: {ticker or 'unavailable'}")
    lines.append(f"- Analysis date: {trade_date or 'unavailable'}")
    if price is not None:
        attribution = market_id or (f"market-{ticker.lower()}" if ticker else "")
        if attribution and as_of:
            lines.append(
                f"- Evidence latest close: {price:.2f} USD "
                f"[source: {attribution}, market CSV as-of {as_of}]"
            )
        elif attribution:
            lines.append(f"- Evidence latest close: {price:.2f} USD [source: {attribution}]")
        else:
            lines.append(f"- Evidence latest close: {price:.2f} USD [source: unavailable]")
    else:
        lines.append("- Evidence latest close: unavailable (no price evidence in this pack)")
    lines.append(f"- Official earnings source: {source_id or 'unavailable'}")
    lines.append(
        "- Contract: identity, date, evidence close and source above are rendered "
        "deterministically from the evidence pack; the generated narrative below is "
        "unmodified model output."
    )
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _strip_existing_header(text: str) -> str:
    """Drop a previous deterministic or upstream report header, keep the body."""
    marker = "\n## "
    idx = text.find(marker)
    if idx != -1:
        return text[idx + 1 :]
    lines = text.splitlines()
    start = 0
    while start < len(lines):
        line = lines[start]
        if not line.strip() or line.startswith("# ") or line.startswith("Generated:"):
            start += 1
            continue
        break
    return "\n".join(lines[start:])


def apply_research_identity_header(complete_report_path: str | Path, header: str) -> Path:
    """Write ``header`` ahead of the generated report body, never duplicating it."""
    path = Path(complete_report_path)
    body = _strip_existing_header(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    path.write_text(
        header + ("\n\n" + body if body.strip() else "") + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return path


def render_run_report(pack: EvidencePack) -> str:
    m = pack.manifest
    lines = [
        render_research_identity(pack),
        "",
        f"# Research Desk Run Report: {m.ticker} on {m.trade_date}",
        "",

+    """Render the deterministic identity/date/evidence-price report contract.
+
+    Every value comes from the actual ``EvidencePack``: the legal company name
+    from ``input.identity`` or the actual ``available_sources.identity``, the
+    ticker/date from the manifest, the close from ``price_from_evidence`` over
+    the pack's own snapshot/corpus, and source IDs from the actual registry.
+    Missing facts are rendered as explicitly unavailable; no case registry is
+    imported and no identity or price is invented.
+    """
+    manifest = pack.manifest
+    identity = dict(pack.input.identity or {})
+    sources = dict(pack.input.available_sources or {})
+    source_identity = dict(sources.get("identity") or {})
+    merged_identity = {
+        **source_identity,
+        **{key: value for key, value in identity.items() if value},
+    }
+    company = _identity_value(merged_identity, "company_name")
+    ticker = (manifest.ticker or "").upper()
+    trade_date = manifest.trade_date or ""
+
+    price = None
+    try:
+        from .graph_adapter import price_from_evidence
+
+        price = price_from_evidence(
+            pack.input.data_snapshot or {},
+            ticker,
+            available_sources=sources,
+        )
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - identity rendering must stay best-effort
+        price = None
+    if price is None:
+        candidate = sources.get("latest_close")
+        if isinstance(candidate, (int, float)):
+            price = float(candidate)
+
+    source_id = _identity_value(sources, "source_id")
+    market_id = _identity_value(sources, "market_source_id")
+    as_of = _identity_value(sources, "as_of")
+
+    lines = [RESEARCH_IDENTITY_TITLE, ""]
+    lines.append(f"- Company (legal identity): {company or 'unavailable'}")
+    lines.append(f"- Ticker: {ticker or 'unavailable'}")
+    lines.append(f"- Analysis date: {trade_date or 'unavailable'}")
+    if price is not None:
+        attribution = market_id or (f"market-{ticker.lower()}" if ticker else "")
+        if attribution and as_of:
+            lines.append(
+                f"- Evidence latest close: {price:.2f} USD "
+                f"[source: {attribution}, market CSV as-of {as_of}]"
+            )
+        elif attribution:
+            lines.append(f"- Evidence latest close: {price:.2f} USD [source: {attribution}]")
+        else:
+            lines.append(f"- Evidence latest close: {price:.2f} USD [source: unavailable]")
+    else:
+        lines.append("- Evidence latest close: unavailable (no price evidence in this pack)")
+    lines.append(f"- Official earnings source: {source_id or 'unavailable'}")
+    lines.append(
+        "- Contract: identity, date, evidence close and source above are rendered "
+        "deterministically from the evidence pack; the generated narrative below is "
+        "unmodified model output."
+    )
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def _strip_existing_header(text: str) -> str:
+    """Drop a previous deterministic or upstream report header, keep the body."""
+    marker = "\n## "
+    idx = text.find(marker)
+    if idx != -1:
+        return text[idx + 1 :]
+    lines = text.splitlines()
+    start = 0
+    while start < len(lines):
+        line = lines[start]
+        if not line.strip() or line.startswith("# ") or line.startswith("Generated:"):
+            start += 1
+            continue
+        break
+    return "\n".join(lines[start:])
+
+
+def apply_research_identity_header(complete_report_path: str | Path, header: str) -> Path:
+    """Write ``header`` ahead of the generated report body, never duplicating it."""
+    path = Path(complete_report_path)
+    body = _strip_existing_header(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    path.write_text(
+        header + ("\n\n" + body if body.strip() else "") + "\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    return path
+
